package.name: truck_tasks
package.description: Task bus for the Ground Pounder: a task manager that queues/arbitrates tasks from any source (web page, LLM planner, object detector), and executor modules - navigator ("goto": A* on the SLAM map + car-like pure pursuit) and explorer ("map_room": frontier exploration). JSON over std_msgs/String so plugins in any language can join. Python 3.6 compatible.
